name: Matthias Oster
headline: Project Lead / Senior Developer at Supercomputing Systems
summary:
My experience spans from the embedded software of a sophisticated medical device to a full-scale cloud IT project, from embedded real-time C++ to Java EE, functional F# and Infrastructur-as-Code. My ambition is to dive into complex systems and master them with a clean design - always a challenge.
Since I love my family with 4 kids, I'm currently available at 80%. I'm interested in job-shared lead-, architect- and senior development opportunities. Important for me is to learn something new in an environment that supports it, a diverse team and a good cause!

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Project lead for the Swisseldex Datahub, a data exchange hub for the energy industries in Switzerland.

My role spanned the lifecycle from of the project from leading the development teams, operations to handover. I'm still responsible for maintenance of the application itself.

The datahub is a comprehensive IT project, including development, 24/7 operations and support. It features a Java / F# service-oriented architeture in a highly available Kubernetes cloud setup on Azure.
Special focus is on the security aspects with identity and access management, a formal security concept, external review and penetration testing and application-specific encryption for the underlying data.

Project Milestones:
Oct 2016: successful bid
Apr 2018: start of specification and development
Apr 2020: release of routing functionality
Oct 2021: release of metering point register
May 2022: last release of main project with the SDAT web client
Nov 2023: after various smaller extension, release of support for OSTRAL
Jul 2025: handover of infrastructure and support, keeping responsible for maintenance of the application.

My roles in this project are:
- Overall project manager (2018 - 2020 and again since 2023)
- Team lead for the development and infrastructure team (up to 5 people)
- SW architect
- Principal developer, as time permits (Java, F#)
- Cloud operations (since 2022)
- 3rd level support for the 3-people telephone and ticketing support team
- Pikett duties
- Currently: further development and keeping the application up-to-date.
